_note: Contoso Dentistry is fictional. Every detail below is invented for the Udacity project. This file is the single source of practice facts: build-faq.js turns `qna` into FAQ-extended.tsv, and website tests check the site shows the same address, phone and hours.
name: Contoso Dentistry

qna.answer: We're at 1200 Harbor Avenue, Suite 210, Seattle, WA 98101 — on the second floor above the Harbor Café.
Free parking is available in the building's garage — bring your ticket to the front desk and we'll validate it. Several bus routes stop at Harbor Ave & 3rd, one block away.
questions: Can I take the bus to your office?

qna.answer: We're open Monday to Friday 8am–5pm and Saturday 9am–1pm. We're closed on Sundays.

Our team: Dr. Amara Okafor (lead dentist, general and cosmetic care), Dr. Luis Herrera (family and children's dentistry), Dr. Mei Tanaka (orthodontist — braces and clear aligners) and Jordan Price (dental hygienist).
Dr. Mei Tanaka is our orthodontist. She offers traditional braces and clear aligners for teens and adults.
questions: Do you offer Invisalign or clear aligners?
Can I get my teeth straightened?

qna.answer: We offer check-ups and cleanings, fillings, crowns and bridges, teeth whitening, braces and clear aligners, and same-day emergency care.
For a dental emergency, call us on (555) 010-2024 — we keep same-day slots for urgent pain, swelling or a broken tooth. Outside opening hours, our voicemail gives the on-call dentist's number.
questions: I have tooth pain, what should I do?
What if I need a dentist after hours?

qna.answer: You can call us on (555) 010-2024 or email hello@contosodentistry.example. We reply to emails within one business day.
Please give us at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or move an appointment — just call (555) 010-2024.
questions: How do I cancel my appointment?
Is there a fee for missing an appointment?

qna.answer: We accept most PPO dental plans, all major cards and HSA/FSA cards, and offer interest-free payment plans for up to 12 months.
questions: Can I pay with my HSA card?

qna.answer: Welcome! Please arrive 15 minutes early for your first visit and bring a photo ID, your insurance card if you have one, and a list of any medications you take.
